title: Lamina Optimized
description: A lightweight and performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to run smoothly on low-end systems without sacrificing core gameplay.
body:
Lamina Optimized is a lightweight and performance-optimized modpack designed to maximize your Minecraft FPS without compromising the vanilla experience.

Whether you have a low-end PC or just want smoother gameplay, Lamina Optimized improves performance through a carefully selected list of mods such as Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and more. These mods work together to reduce lag, speed up chunk loading, and lower memory usage — making your game faster, smoother, and more responsive.

💡 Key Features:
⚡ FPS boost up to 200% on low-end systems

🧠 Memory optimization to reduce stuttering

🔍 Clear and clean visuals without shader bloat

🧩 Compatible with most Fabric mods

🎮 Plug-and-play setup — no config needed

This pack is ideal for PvP, building, or just exploring — with no unnecessary clutter.
